purpose: Bounded CPU-only descriptive audit of all published pairwise throughput channels in CooperScene mcap_preview/9.mcap.

sourceArtifact.downloadScope: Only the official mcap_preview/9.mcap object was downloaded for this bounded sample.
sourceArtifact.hashInterpretation: The SHA-256 was computed locally over the complete downloaded object; no publisher-supplied hash for this preview object was found during the audit.

parser.method: Stream top-level MCAP records; decompress one zstd chunk at a time; verify every non-zero chunk CRC; retain only directed throughput messages.
parser.zstdVersion: *** Zstandard CLI (64-bit) v1.5.7, by Yann Collet ***
parser.residentScope: One compressed chunk, one decompressed chunk, and 1932 scalar throughput rows.

measurementSemantics.unitCaveat: Mbps remains an inference from the official cv2x_throughput configuration and benchmark documentation; the Vector3 schema contains no unit metadata.
measurementSemantics.yAndZInterpretation: No semantic meaning is assigned. Their observed distributions are reported without relabeling them as latency, loss, or jitter.
measurementSemantics.nominalSamplingBasis: The official paper and benchmark describe 10 Hz perception and 100 ms network reports.

statisticsMethod.ordering: Per-channel messages are checked in MCAP file order and sorted by log_time only for descriptive statistics.
statisticsMethod.quantiles: Linear interpolation over sorted observations at p05, p25, p50, p75, and p95.
statisticsMethod.autocorrelation: Biased sample ACF: sum((x_t-mean)(x_t-lag-mean)) divided by the full-series centered sum of squares.
statisticsMethod.missingWithinReceiver: For each receiver, use the union of exact log timestamps from its three inbound links and count absent timestamps per link.
statisticsMethod.nominalMissingSlots: For sorted gaps greater than 150 ms, estimate skipped 100 ms slots as round(gap/100 ms)-1. This is reported separately from exact receiver-timeline missingness.
statisticsMethod.lowThroughput: Use the preregistered, data-independent thresholds 0.1, 0.25, and 0.5 Mbps with strict comparison x < threshold; runs are contiguous samples in log-time order.

crossLinkCorrelation.alignmentMethod: For each unordered link pair, pair the lexicographically earlier link with the nearest unused log timestamp in the later link, preserving order, with an absolute tolerance of 50 ms; compute once and mirror the result so every matrix is symmetric.
limitations: Within each receiver, all three incoming links use exact shared timestamps.
Across receivers, the 50 ms nearest-neighbor pairing is an explicit bounded approximation.
Correlation does not identify shared radio causes, congestion, or causal dependence.

acrossAllTwelveNearestTimestamp.alignmentMethod: Use the lexicographically first directed link as an anchor and pair every other link to its nearest unused log timestamp within 50 ms; retain only anchor rows matched across all 12 links.
acrossAllTwelveNearestTimestamp.limitation: This is a bounded cross-link network summary, not a verified mapping to perception frame filenames.

previewAlignmentAssessment.reason: The preview MCAP provides log and publish times plus sensor messages on the same MCAP time axis, but it does not expose an audited mapping from Unix-epoch MCAP time to original scene ZIP frame filenames such as 540600-540760.
previewAlignmentAssessment.ordinalAlignmentStatus: The 161 samples per directed link and 161 scene frames make ordinal alignment plausible, but equal counts and sorted order are not a verified producer contract.
previewAlignmentAssessment.requiredArtifact: A per-take, producer-verified or independently validated MCAP-time-to-frame-filename sidecar with monotonicity, duplicate, missing, and maximum alignment-error checks.

explicitLimitations: The preview object is a visualization derivative; this audit does not assume its LiDAR or image payloads are equivalent to full-resolution training data.
No independent latency, packet-loss, jitter, packet-event, RSSI, PHY, MAC, or scheduling field was decoded.
Throughput correlations do not establish shared causes or contention mechanisms.
The 50 ms cross-receiver pairing is a bounded summary method, not a perception-frame correspondence.
No perception checkpoint, detector, fusion model, or GPU workload was run.
prohibitions: Do not relabel Vector3.y or Vector3.z as latency, loss, or jitter.
Do not call throughput-derived completion delay measured end-to-end latency.
Do not claim packet-loss or jitter replay from this preview.
Do not treat nearest-timestamp or ordinal network alignment as a verified mapping to original perception frame filenames.
Do not infer causal radio mechanisms from the descriptive ACF or cross-link correlation matrix.
Do not generalize take 9 preview statistics to other takes or the full CooperScene distribution.
